subject.title: fix(subagents): preserve requester wake on visible delivery failure

question: After a requester completion turn has already run but lacks required message-tool evidence, should OpenClaw terminally record visible-delivery failure or implement an isolated retry that cannot replay the requester turn and its side effects?
rationale: The current PR retries the full agent turn, while choosing terminal failure versus a new isolated delivery operation changes the permanent orchestration and delivery-safety contract.

options.title: Build isolated visible retry
options.body: Persist a delivery-only operation that can retry the required visible output without re-injecting the completion into the requester agent.

options.title: Make missing evidence terminal
options.body: Preserve requester wake success but mark visible delivery failed immediately when no replay-safe visible-send operation exists.

options.title: Pause this contract change
options.body: Keep current behavior until agents owners define a replay-safe requester-wake and visible-delivery boundary.

recommendation.title: Build isolated visible retry
recommendation.body: Persist a delivery-only operation that can retry the required visible output without re-injecting the completion into the requester agent.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the lifecycle, persisted registry state, and announce-delivery boundary involved in this decision.
